issues.title: [RB-001] Pin Godot toolchain and initialize repository
issues.goal: Establish a reproducible Godot/GDScript repository without Flutter or unnecessary native modules.
implementation_steps: Pin editor and matching export templates to ENGINE_VERSION; document exact local version output.
Create the proposed directories, ignore engine caches/secrets, and add a simple boot scene.
Document clean import, domain-test, and debug-export commands once verified.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout imports on a second workstation or clean runner.
No generated cache, signing secret, Flutter project, or mandatory Kotlin dependency is committed.
Repository documents the exact engine/export-template pairing.
issues.required_evidence: Clean import log, version output, reviewed repository tree.

issues.title: [RB-002] Select physical Android test matrix
issues.goal: Replace unsupported device assumptions with an explicit minimum/target test inventory.
implementation_steps: Choose minimum-tier, mid-tier, and alternate-GPU phones from available inventory.
Record OS, renderer support, audio routes, screen aspect and safe-area characteristics.
Define the baseline performance/privacy evidence worksheet.
acceptance_criteria: At least three actual devices are identified with owners/access.
Proposed minimum Android support is marked unapproved until tests pass.
Bluetooth, interruptions, and notch/navigation conditions are represented.
issues.required_evidence: Device matrix and planned test assignments.

issues.title: [RB-003] Benchmark Mobile and Compatibility renderers
issues.goal: Choose a measured mobile rendering baseline before producing final course art.
implementation_steps: Build a representative turf/island/ball/light/particle test scene.
Compare release-like builds with Mobile and Compatibility on the matrix.
Record frame-time distribution, memory, visual differences, and selected baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Decision includes measured p95/p99 data, not only average FPS.
Target/low tiers are named with limitations and renderer-specific concerns.
No renderer switch is hidden inside an ordinary graphics-quality toggle.
issues.required_evidence: Benchmark scene, raw metrics, comparison screenshots, renderer ADR.

issues.title: [RB-004] Validate Jolt ball, ramp, and collision behavior
issues.goal: Prove the chosen physics baseline can support rolling, ramps, and high-speed impacts.
implementation_steps: Create diagnostic flat-roll, ramp, and thin-barrier scenes.
Use the proposed sphere scale, fixed physics rate, and CCD; sweep candidate impulses.
Record tuning concerns and engine-specific limitations.
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable tunneling in the diagnostic power range.
A repeatable resting/rolling approach is documented.
Selected engine, tick rate, and tuning version are recorded.
issues.required_evidence: Diagnostic scenes and physical-device/desktop result notes.

issues.title: [RB-005] Prove mic permissions and hardware release lifecycle
issues.goal: Prove explicit capture can start and stop without playback feedback or a misleading privacy indicator.
implementation_steps: Implement the smallest built-in mic/capture bus prototype with no autoplay.
Test permission grant/denial, capture stop, pause/background, repeated holds, and route changes.
Observe OS mic indicator after each transition; document a minimal reproduction if input persists.
acceptance_criteria: No app-level audio recording or upload exists.
Capture never routes audible microphone sound to speakers.
Hardware release result is documented; failures block voice release rather than being relabeled.
A Kotlin evaluation occurs only if supported engine behavior cannot meet the requirement.
issues.required_evidence: Mic lifecycle matrix, privacy-indicator observations, reproduction project if needed.

issues.title: [RB-006] Approve MVP flows and reconcile concept mockups
issues.goal: Freeze a buildable scope instead of implementing every feature printed in the concept art.
implementation_steps: Review first-run, Voice/Touch, play, results, map, and collection journeys.
Map each reference image to keep/change decisions.
Confirm twelve holes, two worlds, three cosmetics, and omitted economy features.
acceptance_criteria: No hearts, shop, daily challenge, gems, or voice-score metric in MVP requirements.
Every essential denial/cancel/loading/save error has a planned path.
PRD and UI spec precedence over mockups is explicit.
issues.required_evidence: Approved flow review and reference reconciliation.

issues.title: [RB-007] Implement typed shot, score, and tuning domain contracts
issues.goal: Create a pure shared contract for input power, physics impulse, and result scoring.
implementation_steps: Implement ShotCommand/result data and normalized power-to-impulse helper.
Reject zero/non-finite/invalid input and validate horizontal direction.
Add scoring functions and versioned tuning resource.
acceptance_criteria: Touch and Voice have one curve with identical constants.
Boundary tests cover p=0, p=1, invalid numbers, and star thresholds.
No UI, audio, or physics-node dependency exists in pure math functions.
issues.required_evidence: Unit tests and contract review.

issues.title: [RB-008] Implement authoritative gameplay state machine
issues.goal: Centralize shot acceptance, token invalidation, stroke ownership, and terminal events.
implementation_steps: Implement documented states and guarded transitions.
Queue immutable commands for the physics tick and reject duplicate shot IDs.
Handle cancellation before commit and coalesce cup/fall terminal events.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate release produces at most one shot/stroke.
Background before physics commit cancels without a spent stroke.
Only GameSessionController writes stroke totals and result state.
issues.required_evidence: Transition tests with fake input and clock.

issues.title: [RB-009] Create level wrapper and scene-marker contract
issues.goal: Define the reusable authored level scene used by all holes.
implementation_steps: Create wrapper nodes for visuals, collision, Spawn, Cup, kill region, bounds, and safe anchors.
Set collision-layer names and validate mandatory markers.
Separate imported GLB art from gameplay-owned collision/scripts.
acceptance_criteria: A minimal scene loads by validated ID.
Missing required markers produces an actionable validation error.
Reimported art does not overwrite gameplay nodes.
issues.required_evidence: Example graybox scene and validator output.

issues.title: [RB-010] Implement ball impulse and rolling resistance
issues.goal: Build a stable spherical physics controller rather than visually animating a fake trajectory.
implementation_steps: Apply each accepted impulse exactly once on the physics tick.
Implement support-aware rolling resistance without suppressing flight/gravity.
Keep cosmetic transforms separate and expose settlement metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Physics rate stays fixed at 60 Hz across quality tiers.
Flat roll distance is measured at four powers.
No per-frame impulse multiplication or nonuniform collider scaling.
issues.required_evidence: Regression scene recordings and tuning table.

issues.title: [RB-011] Implement playfield aiming and input ownership
issues.goal: Provide intentional touch aim without UI fall-through or camera conflicts.
implementation_steps: Map playfield drag to bounded horizontal aim.
Exclude UI hit regions and assign pointer ownership.
Draw a short obstacle-clipped direction guide, not an exact landing prediction.
acceptance_criteria: Dragging a UI control never changes world aim.
Aim locks during capture and shot commit.
Narrow-screen gestures remain usable with one thumb.
issues.required_evidence: Touch gesture tests and phone-scale recording.

issues.title: [RB-012] Implement complete Touch shot controls
issues.goal: Make the entire game playable independently of microphone access.
implementation_steps: Create power slider, Shoot, disabled states, and input-mode intent.
Route Touch into the same ShotCommand as Voice.
Reject zero power and moving-ball shots.
acceptance_criteria: Touch can complete the graybox hole with mic permission denied.
Same input value yields the shared impulse with no bonus/penalty.
Shoot is unambiguous and never fires from slider release alone.
issues.required_evidence: Touch-only end-to-end test.

issues.title: [RB-013] Implement Ready, Follow, and Overview cameras
issues.goal: Maintain readable course framing through aiming, flight, reset, and device aspect changes.
implementation_steps: Use authored course bounds and next-target framing.
Implement smoothed follow and fixed Ready-only Overview with paused simulation.
Lock camera during capture; add Reduced Motion handling.
acceptance_criteria: Ball and target remain clear of HUD in reference sizes.
Overview cannot be used to exploit unpaused hazard timing.
Falling camera does not dive into the void.
issues.required_evidence: Portrait/narrow/tablet captures and camera state tests.

issues.title: [RB-014] Implement support, rest detection, and safe anchors
issues.goal: Allow shooting only after real supported rest and record recoverable positions.
implementation_steps: Apply speed/angular/support-duration thresholds.
Validate anchor slope, clearance, and distance from hazards.
Exclude moving surfaces, cup, portals, and pads from safe resting anchors.
acceptance_criteria: A midair apex or slowly sliding slope does not become Ready.
Ball can settle reliably on intended turf.
Unsafe/blocked anchors fall back to an authored checkpoint.
issues.required_evidence: Rest/anchor integration tests.

issues.title: [RB-015] Implement out-of-bounds and stuck recovery
issues.goal: Recover from falls predictably with one penalty and no infinite reset loop.
implementation_steps: Coalesce kill-plane and kill-volume events by shot ID.
Reset through a safe physics state and clear residual velocity/forces.
Add explicit stuck-recovery option after the watchdog period.
acceptance_criteria: One fall adds exactly one penalty in addition to the committed shot.
Repeated trigger events cannot create repeated penalties.
Blocked safe anchor uses fallback; confirmed recovery does not silently erase score.
issues.required_evidence: Fall/reset/blocked-anchor tests and recording.

issues.title: [RB-016] Implement cup capture and completion ownership
issues.goal: Finish only when the ball actually qualifies for cup capture.
implementation_steps: Build visual opening/rim and separate eligibility trigger.
Check distance, height, and speed; send one terminal completion.
Run cosmetic sink/celebration after scoring authority disables fall reactions.
acceptance_criteria: Slow valid entry completes once.
High flyover, fast pass, and underside entry do not win.
Animation signals cannot duplicate a result.
issues.required_evidence: Cup regression scene and tests.

issues.title: [RB-017] Implement stars, attempt limits, and unlock rules
issues.goal: Encode unambiguous scoring and sequential progression without an economy.
implementation_steps: Implement 3/2/1-star thresholds and twelve-stroke attempt resolution.
Apply penalties before failure resolution and allow completion on stroke twelve.
Derive next-hole and cosmetic unlocks from completed levels.
acceptance_criteria: Par/par+1/par+2 produce 3/2/1 stars for valid completion.
Eleven strokes plus shot plus fall resolves thirteen and fails.
One-star CC06 unlocks PP01 and Panda.
issues.required_evidence: Boundary and unlock unit tests.

issues.title: [RB-018] Build shared Godot UI theme and safe-area shell
issues.goal: Translate the reference style into reusable real Controls and responsive layout.
implementation_steps: Implement theme tokens, panels, buttons, typography, and focus/disabled states.
Map physical safe regions into canvas space and configure stretch policy.
Add a UI showcase scene with phone/tablet test layouts.
acceptance_criteria: No full-screen screenshot is used as interactive UI.
Targets meet the proposed logical size and text is not baked into art.
Safe-area tests pass at narrow/tall/notched sizes.
issues.required_evidence: Theme showcase captures and layout tests.

issues.title: [RB-019] Implement mode choice and contextual permission UX
issues.goal: Request microphone access only after a clear voluntary choice.
implementation_steps: Build Voice/Touch selection and privacy pre-prompt.
Handle asynchronous grant/denial/permanent denial with supported OS APIs.
Persist selected input mode and provide settings recovery without prompt loops.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh boot and Touch flow do not prompt for microphone.
Denied permission still allows all gameplay.
Permission result is not confused with a synchronous return value.
issues.required_evidence: Fresh-install permission matrix.

issues.title: [RB-020] Implement bounded VoiceInputService and silent monitoring
issues.goal: Expose validated short-window digital sound levels without storing player audio.
implementation_steps: Create capture provider with token ownership and fresh-frame readiness.
Use energy across both stereo channels and a bounded ring buffer.
Handle silence, non-finite values, clipping, no input, and overruns.
acceptance_criteria: No microphone sound is audible through output.
Old frames cannot power a new capture session.
No file/network/log path receives PCM.
issues.required_evidence: Synthetic tests, bus diagram, input lifecycle evidence.

issues.title: [RB-021] Implement room/soft/strong calibration
issues.goal: Make comfortable relative sound levels usable across devices without escalating effort.
implementation_steps: Collect valid window percentiles/medians for three explicit stages.
Apply range/noise/clipping checks and keep previous calibration on failure.
Store only versioned numeric thresholds; invalidate on route changes.
acceptance_criteria: Too-noisy or too-small range shows recovery/Touch, not forced louder prompts.
Soft and strong can be achieved comfortably on test devices.
No hardware identifier or audio recording is stored.
issues.required_evidence: Calibration fixtures and device observation sheet.

issues.title: [RB-022] Implement preview power and stable release selection
issues.goal: Ensure displayed Shot power is precisely the value committed on release.
implementation_steps: Implement frame-time-aware smoothing and 250 ms recent window.
Require at least 150 ms valid data and calculate the 75th percentile preview.
Expire stale preview and publish validity separately from live level.
acceptance_criteria: Preview-to-command difference is <=0.01 for accepted releases.
A single transient/no-signal hold cannot launch.
Frame-jitter and stale-buffer fixtures pass.
issues.required_evidence: Window/quantile tests and debug value comparison.

issues.title: [RB-023] Connect hold/release/cancel voice gestures
issues.goal: Deliver the complete intentional voice-shot interaction.
implementation_steps: Implement warmup/listening UI states and initiating-pointer ownership.
Lock camera/aim during hold and add explicit cancel region.
Reject timeout, duplicate release, interruption, and invalid preview.
acceptance_criteria: One valid release adds one stroke and impulse.
Cancel and >3 second hold never auto-fire.
Secondary touches and UI navigation cannot create unintended shots.
issues.required_evidence: Gesture/state regression tests and phone recording.

issues.title: [RB-024] Handle pause, background, route changes, and scene disposal
issues.goal: Make capture and simulation lifecycle safe across real application interruptions.
implementation_steps: Cancel uncommitted commands on pause/background and invalidate capture IDs.
Pause/resume rolling physics and gate phase consistently.
Stop input/listeners and dispose sessions on scene exit; do not auto-restart mic.
acceptance_criteria: Privacy indicator and capture ownership tests pass on target devices.
Returning during a prior hold cannot launch a shot.
Thirty game entry/exit cycles leave one live session at most.
issues.required_evidence: Lifecycle matrix and stress-run logs.

issues.title: [RB-025] Implement game audio ducking and nonverbal feedback
issues.goal: Support gameplay feedback without contaminating voice measurement.
implementation_steps: Add separate music/effects/microphone routing and capture ducking.
Trigger mascot roar and shot sounds only after capture closes.
Support volume, muted mode, and no mandatory audio cues.
acceptance_criteria: The game cannot power itself from its own UI/mascot sound in normal tests.
Muted players can complete using visual cues.
All audio has recorded provenance and no user voice clips.
issues.required_evidence: Mixer checks and speaker/headphone tests.

issues.title: [RB-026] Pass one-hole end-to-end playable-loop gate
issues.goal: Prove the full game loop before polished content or twelve-hole production.
implementation_steps: Assemble one graybox hole with a simple ramp and safe recovery.
Run Home to completion to persisted result to retry in Voice and Touch.
Document remaining engineering risks with real-device evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A denied-mic install still completes and saves the hole.
Voice path shows correct preview/stroke/cancel behavior.
No critical physics, capture-release, or progress-loss defect remains for the slice.
issues.required_evidence: End-to-end device recordings, gate checklist, test logs.

issues.title: [RB-027] Create lion mascot production asset and expressions
issues.goal: Build the recognizable lion-ball visual as an actual optimized 3D asset.
implementation_steps: Author/export a compact sphere-compatible model with clean materials.
Implement idle/focus/rolling/surprise/success expressions.
Verify visual pivot and collider independence after import.
acceptance_criteria: Lion reads clearly at gameplay size.
Collider, mass, and shot tuning are unchanged by the art.
Asset source, license/provenance, and triangle/material counts are recorded.
issues.required_evidence: GLB/source inventory, in-game phone-scale captures.

issues.title: [RB-028] Create modular course kit and collision wrappers
issues.goal: Enable varied holes without individually sculpting every complete course.
implementation_steps: Build straight/corner/green/ramp/rail/cliff modules on consistent scale/grid.
Attach simplified hand-owned collision and clear pivots.
Verify seams with the actual ball at high and low speed.
acceptance_criteria: Module seams do not trap or bounce the ball unexpectedly.
Reimports preserve wrapper interactions.
Budget and provenance inventory covers all modules.
issues.required_evidence: Kit scene, collision regression run, asset inventory.

issues.title: [RB-029] Establish mobile lighting, materials, and quality tiers
issues.goal: Match reference mood through measured stylization rather than expensive cinematic effects.
implementation_steps: Create shared turf/wood/stone materials and lightweight waterfall/background treatment.
Implement measured shadow/particle/resolution quality settings.
Keep gameplay cues visible in the lowest quality tier.
acceptance_criteria: No quality tier changes physics, collider, tick rate, or scoring.
Representative scene meets selected target budgets or records a blocker.
Low quality preserves cup/gate/portal clarity.
issues.required_evidence: Quality comparison captures and frame-time report.

issues.title: [RB-030] Implement Home and loading/error navigation
issues.goal: Build a focused entry screen with real navigation and no mock economy.
implementation_steps: Create hero view, Play, Map, Balls, Settings, and input-mode chip.
Implement meaningful loading and retry/home failures.
Resume the next unlocked hole using validated progress.
acceptance_criteria: Home does not prompt for mic or show unimplemented shop/daily controls.
Loading errors return safely without duplicate sessions.
Buttons are accessible real Controls with pressed/disabled states.
issues.required_evidence: Navigation tests and captures.

issues.title: [RB-031] Implement two-world twelve-hole selection
issues.goal: Provide clear progression without a heavy animated scene per map node.
implementation_steps: Build two chapter cards/map islands with six nodes each.
Show title, par, best result, stars, and specific lock reasons.
Keep actual selection buttons in the responsive UI layer.
acceptance_criteria: All unlock states match domain tests.
One-star completion advances progression.
No shop/hearts/lava-world scope appears as an active feature.
issues.required_evidence: Map state snapshots and progression tests.

issues.title: [RB-032] Polish calibration UI and recovery states
issues.goal: Make calibration understandable and easy to leave without frustration.
implementation_steps: Implement Room/Soft/Strong steps with deliberate Start action and test shot.
Show signal quality, progress, Retry Step, and equally accessible Use Touch.
Keep copy comfortable and distinguish starting/listening/inactive states.
acceptance_criteria: No automatic capture on mere screen navigation.
Denied/no-input/noisy/route-changed states have a recovery path.
No SPL claims or pressure to scream.
issues.required_evidence: All calibration/error-state captures and usability notes.

issues.title: [RB-033] Polish Ready/Capturing/Rolling gameplay HUD
issues.goal: Make the playfield and shot affordances readable on phones.
implementation_steps: Build compact hole/par/stroke/pause header and bottom tray.
Separate live level from committed Shot power and render cancel/disabled states.
Adapt framing and controls for safe areas/narrow screens.
acceptance_criteria: Cup/ball/landing area are not hidden by decorative logo or HUD.
Rolling state does not display misleading mic activity.
Input fallback and Overview are discoverable.
issues.required_evidence: Portrait/narrow/tablet state captures.

issues.title: [RB-034] Implement Pause, Settings, and Android Back behavior
issues.goal: Create predictable navigation and preferences that cannot accidentally commit a shot.
implementation_steps: Implement resume/restart/map and settings controls.
Handle back-stack order and confirmation when abandoning an attempt.
Persist preferences and cancel capture before mode changes.
acceptance_criteria: Resume never starts mic automatically.
Back dismisses sheets before exiting gameplay.
Volume/haptics/reduced-motion/quality/input settings persist.
issues.required_evidence: Back-stack/lifecycle tests and settings captures.

issues.title: [RB-035] Implement truthful results and save-warning UI
issues.goal: Show earned progress without invented voice-quality statistics or fake durable saves.
implementation_steps: Build celebration, stars, strokes/par, progress, Next/Retry/Map.
Handle final hole and failed-attempt variants.
Expose save retry/warning on persistence failure.
acceptance_criteria: No whisper %, accuracy %, gems, or time-based rank is shown.
Final hole routes to map/completion instead of a missing next scene.
Save failures are visible and previous durable progress stays safe.
issues.required_evidence: Result variants and failure-injection tests.

issues.title: [RB-036] Approve one polished visual and interaction slice
issues.goal: Demonstrate reference-quality direction with a real engine scene and real controls.
implementation_steps: Assemble the mascot, course kit, lighting, UI, sounds, and full shot loop in one hole.
Review at phone size against keep/change decisions, not impossible pixel matching.
Profile and run short usability review before scaling content.
acceptance_criteria: Approval includes real-device gameplay video and frame timings.
Buttons, ball, input meter, and camera are functional rather than image overlays.
Major control/readability issues are resolved or block content scaling.
issues.required_evidence: Approved vertical-slice review and measured build.

issues.title: [RB-037] Implement moving gate obstacle
issues.goal: Introduce visible timing puzzles with paused fixed-time motion.
implementation_steps: Create an AnimatableBody3D gate with authored path/period/phase.
Match collision to visuals and communicate movement range.
Pause phase with gameplay and prevent impossible trapping layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Pause/resume does not teleport the obstacle.
Low-speed contact and fast impact are stable.
Gate can be reused by multiple holes without copied logic.
issues.required_evidence: Obstacle test scene and pause/impact tests.

issues.title: [RB-038] Implement paired portals and exit validation
issues.goal: Teleport predictably with direction mapping and no recursive trigger loop.
implementation_steps: Define entry/exit coordinate convention and mapped velocity.
Add radius-clearance checks, per-pair latch, and leaving-trigger condition.
Validate counterpart IDs and unobstructed exits.
acceptance_criteria: One pair preserves allowed speed and maps direction as designed.
Ball cannot repeatedly teleport while inside an exit.
Invalid pair/blocked exit fails validation or safely rejects entry.
issues.required_evidence: Portal unit/integration tests and visual pairing review.

issues.title: [RB-039] Implement one-shot bounce pad
issues.goal: Create a reusable pad without per-frame energy accumulation.
implementation_steps: Add authored impulse vector/strength and contact latch.
Coordinate compression/pulse visual with actual impulse.
Apply speed containment and test side/slow/repeated entries.
acceptance_criteria: One eligible entry produces one impulse.
Remaining inside the trigger does not continue acceleration.
Pad effect remains readable in reduced quality/motion.
issues.required_evidence: Pad regression scene and event-count tests.

issues.title: [RB-040] Author and validate Cloud Cliffs holes 1–3
issues.goal: Teach putting, restraint, and rebounds through distinct forgiving layouts.
implementation_steps: Build CC01–CC03 according to catalog goals with actual `.tscn` scenes.
Playtest safe routes, alternate choices, power bands, and par proposals.
Verify touch-only completion, camera framing, and safe anchors.
acceptance_criteria: Each of three holes has an independent successful route record.
Primary early routes have forgiving power bands rather than single exact values.
Metadata status changes only with attached evidence.
issues.required_evidence: Three scenes, solution evidence, validation output.

issues.title: [RB-041] Author and validate Cloud Cliffs holes 4–6
issues.goal: Introduce ramps/gate timing and combine them without a sudden difficulty wall.
implementation_steps: Build CC04–CC06 with ramps, safe landings, and gate layouts.
Test one-star progression and Panda/PP01 unlock after CC06.
Tune pars from measured routes and document common failures.
acceptance_criteria: All three holes are independently completed in the pinned build.
No inevitable gate trap or inaccessible reset location.
World completion unlock behavior matches PRD.
issues.required_evidence: Three scenes, balance notes, unlock run.

issues.title: [RB-042] Author and validate Portal Peaks holes 1–3
issues.goal: Teach portal pairing, exit direction, and bounce pads one at a time.
implementation_steps: Build PP01–PP03 with at most one visible portal pair per hole.
Keep exit destinations and pad landing areas inspectable.
Validate exit clearance, re-entry latch, and power tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Each hole has its own teaching focus and completed route.
No invisible teleport destination or mandatory exact-volume trick.
Safe recovery works after misses.
issues.required_evidence: Three scenes, route evidence, trigger tests.

issues.title: [RB-043] Author and validate Portal Peaks holes 4–6
issues.goal: Deliver a satisfying finale through recombination rather than unbounded new systems.
implementation_steps: Build PP04–PP06 using existing mechanics and meaningful alternate decisions.
Avoid adding wind/lava/moving-platform scope.
Tune final pars and complete Robot/final-results progression.
acceptance_criteria: All final holes are independently solved on the pinned build.
PP06 completion ends cleanly and equips only earned cosmetics.
No unavoidable precision beyond tested intended difficulty.
issues.required_evidence: Three scenes, finale run, solution reports.

issues.title: [RB-044] Implement three cosmetic balls and collection screen
issues.goal: Reward completion with Lion, Panda, and Robot without changing physics.
implementation_steps: Author Panda/Robot visuals using the same sphere contract.
Build one live preview and three static cards with clear lock criteria.
Separate selected preview from equipped state and persist equipment.
acceptance_criteria: All cosmetics use identical physics resources/collider settings.
Locked preview cannot be equipped.
No rarity, purchase, currency, or random unlock subsystem is required.
issues.required_evidence: Cosmetic equality tests and collection states.

issues.title: [RB-045] Implement validated local progress/settings and recovery
issues.goal: Preserve completed progress through duplicate events and interrupted writes.
implementation_steps: Implement schema validation, best-result merge, and derived unlocks.
Write/validate temp snapshots, preserve last-good backup, and check replacement errors.
Separate settings/calibration from progress and expose save failure status.
acceptance_criteria: Worse replay/duplicate completion never erases a best result.
Truncated/future-schema/invalid values fail safely.
Failure at each write step preserves a valid prior durable copy where available.
issues.required_evidence: Migration/merge fixtures and write-failure tests.

issues.title: [RB-046] Implement content catalog and scene validators
issues.goal: Catch content errors before they appear as broken gameplay.
implementation_steps: Validate JSON schema plus unique IDs/order/count/path/known mechanics.
Inspect required scene markers, safe anchors, portal pairs, and exit clearance.
Separate design metadata validation from real scene/solvability evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Design-only catalog cannot be mislabeled production-validated.
Missing scene or marker fails the shipping build gate.
Every error reports level ID and actionable detail.
issues.required_evidence: Valid/invalid fixtures and build-gate output.

issues.title: [RB-047] Run all-hole playtest and balance review
issues.goal: Prove all twelve holes are playable, distinct, and fair in both input modes.
implementation_steps: Run independent routes and power bands across every hole.
Review progression, par, stroke-limit failures, reset positions, and cosmetics.
Collect representative novice usability feedback without retaining voice recordings.
acceptance_criteria: Each hole has independent completion evidence and approved par.
Full Touch run earns the same rewards as Voice.
No critical unfair trap, hidden target, or unexplained failure remains.
issues.required_evidence: Twelve-hole matrix, playtest notes, corrected catalog.

issues.title: [RB-048] Conditional: add narrowly scoped Kotlin input/platform adapter
issues.goal: Address a demonstrated Android capability gap only after built-in engine validation fails.
implementation_steps: Approve a reproduction-based ADR and finalize the smallest platform contract.
Use version-matched Godot v2 plugin packaging with exact exposed method names.
Own/release native resources safely; disable competing built-in capture when applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Absent plugin preserves functional Touch/default supported path.
Two-device tests prove the original gap is fixed with no second input owner.
No gameplay, UI, score, or cloud audio service is moved into Kotlin.
issues.required_evidence: Approved ADR, minimal reproduction, native build and lifecycle matrix.

issues.title: [RB-049] Externalize strings and prepare English/Indonesian localization
issues.goal: Keep all interface copy editable and localizable rather than baked into art.
implementation_steps: Move UI strings and errors into stable localization keys.
Complete English and review Indonesian translations when available.
Test longer strings and number formatting at narrow width.
acceptance_criteria: No important instruction exists only in a texture.
Missing keys are detected automatically.
No clipping or mixed-language accidental fallback in selected locale.
issues.required_evidence: Localization key audit and language captures.

issues.title: [RB-050] Verify accessibility, reduced motion, and equal Touch path
issues.goal: Ensure sound, motion, or voice ability is never a gate to completion.
implementation_steps: Run full Touch/no-sound/reduced-motion journeys.
Check logical target sizes, visual/text state cues, safe areas, contrast, and focus.
Document supported accessibility behavior honestly.
acceptance_criteria: All content/rewards accessible without microphone.
Color/audio/haptics are not the sole carrier of critical instructions.
No unsupported blanket accessibility compliance claim is made.
issues.required_evidence: Accessibility checklist, screenshots, observed limitations.

issues.title: [RB-051] Build automated domain/state/scene regression suite
issues.goal: Make the core contracts resistant to regressions during polish and content changes.
implementation_steps: Automate unit fixtures for math, scoring, unlocks, saves, and invalid input.
Add fake-clock/input state tests and diagnostic scene tests.
Run headless import/parse plus content gates in clean CI.
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail intentionally when a contract is broken.
Synthetic success is not reported as a passed hardware/GPU test.
CI commands/toolchain are pinned and documented.
issues.required_evidence: CI runs, fixture inventory, intentional-failure demonstration.

issues.title: [RB-052] Profile and optimize sustained mobile performance
issues.goal: Meet measured target/low tiers without changing gameplay behavior.
implementation_steps: Run fifteen-minute release-like soaks on the full device matrix.
Identify CPU/GPU/audio/UI/resource bottlenecks and tune budgets.
Compare low/high tiers for visual cues and physics parity.
acceptance_criteria: Selected tiers meet agreed p95/p99/memory/thermal gates or block release.
Repeated levels do not show unbounded resource growth.
Optimizations do not change collision, tick rate, power, or score.
issues.required_evidence: Profiler report, before/after data, signed-off device support.

issues.title: [RB-053] Audit privacy, permissions, storage, and dependency provenance
issues.goal: Confirm player-facing privacy claims match the actual implementation.
implementation_steps: Inspect merged manifest, network activity, logs, saves, and crash attachments.
Verify native mic release and no persistent audio on target builds.
Review dependencies/assets and remove unused permissions/SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: No PCM/transcript/audio upload or production amplitude history.
Hardware capture lifetime matches honest UI copy.
Asset/dependency licenses are recorded and no signing secret is committed.
issues.required_evidence: Audit report, manifest/storage/network evidence.

issues.title: [RB-054] Run mobile interruption and navigation stability suite
issues.goal: Exercise the complete app through real-life interruptions and repeated use.
implementation_steps: Run thirty scene and capture cycles, permission revocation, route changes, and back-stack flows.
Test process kills during save and rolling/capturing suspension.
Validate load/save failures and no duplicate sessions.
acceptance_criteria: No critical crash, accidental shot, lingering capture, or progress-loss defect.
Background never advances gate phase or spends a pending shot.
Recovery copy and actions work in the release-like build.
issues.required_evidence: Full device stability matrix and resolved-defect list.

issues.title: [RB-055] Create reproducible signed Android release candidate
issues.goal: Produce the actual tested release artifact with secure signing and exact toolchain records.
implementation_steps: Configure publisher-owned identifier, release export, and secure signing.
Capture build/SDK/template versions and artifact checksums.
Install the signed candidate and repeat offline/permission/save smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: No production secrets are in Git or the handoff package.
Release build, not only debug, passes critical smoke tests.
Artifact version and source commit are traceable.
issues.required_evidence: Signed artifact metadata/checksum and release smoke report.

issues.title: [RB-056] Prepare store materials, policy review, and asset/name clearance
issues.goal: Prepare truthful release materials and obtain publisher decisions before submission.
implementation_steps: Use actual in-engine screenshots, not concept images presented as gameplay.
Review current store target-API/privacy/content requirements and audience classification.
Complete asset licenses, final name check, support contact, and privacy copy.
acceptance_criteria: Store claims match implemented offline/voice behavior.
Publisher has recorded audience/name/license decisions.
No compliance/approval guarantee is asserted from this checklist.
issues.required_evidence: Reviewed submission checklist and real-build screenshot set.

issues.title: [RB-057] Approve MVP release gate and hand over operations
issues.goal: Conclude the MVP only when product, engineering, and release evidence agree.
implementation_steps: Review all P0/P1 MVP task evidence and unresolved defects.
Verify twelve holes, three cosmetics, offline progress, and both input modes.
Document known limitations, rollback/rebuild procedure, and follow-up backlog.
acceptance_criteria: No unresolved critical/major issue without explicit release decision.
Release source/artifact/tests are traceable.
MVP scope is completed without conditional/later work silently claimed.
issues.required_evidence: Signed release checklist and handover notes.

issues.title: [RB-058] Later: evaluate standalone iOS export and audio lifecycle
issues.goal: Plan an independent iOS release track only after Android MVP evidence exists.
implementation_steps: Provision macOS/Xcode and matching Godot export templates.
Test iOS microphone/session/permission behavior and Swift bridge needs if any.
Define signing, device matrix, and release scope separately.
acceptance_criteria: No claim that Kotlin solves iOS integration.
Physical iOS capture/lifecycle evidence precedes feature parity claims.
New platform work has approved scope.
issues.required_evidence: iOS feasibility ADR and test plan.

issues.title: [RB-059] Later: evaluate wind/lava worlds and daily challenges
issues.goal: Expand only after the base game proves satisfying and maintainable.
implementation_steps: Prioritize new mechanics from playtest evidence, not every old concept element.
Prototype wind/fan or a new world one at a time.
Define deterministic challenge content/clock policy before a daily system.
acceptance_criteria: Separate approved PRD defines new content and regression impact.
New mechanic does not compromise comfortable Voice/Touch parity.
No new world is marketed before actual validation.
issues.required_evidence: Expansion proposal and prototype review.

issues.title: [RB-060] Later: review online analytics or monetization as separate scope
issues.goal: Prevent unreviewed SDK/data collection from creeping into an offline family-friendly design.
implementation_steps: State the business/user problem before selecting SDKs.
Define consent, minimization, security, retention, audience, and store review requirements.
Keep raw player audio out of scope unless a separately reviewed feature truly requires it.
acceptance_criteria: No network/account/ad/payment feature is added without an approved review.
Touch/Voice parity is preserved.
Data claims and dependencies are audited before shipping.
issues.required_evidence: Separate product/privacy/security design.
